turns.question: What is our net revenue for the fiscal year to date, as of the end of 6 October 2026?
turns.answer: Net revenue for the fiscal year to date is EUR 19,521.84, covering 1 February 2026 to 6 October 2026 (fiscal 2026 starts 1 February).
